# `m.stocks.luld`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Limit up-limit down price bands of US-listed stocks, as they change.

```python
m.stocks.luld(symbols)
```

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Limit Up - Limit Down (LULD) (WebSocket) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Not included |
| Stocks Starter | Not included |
| Stocks Developer | Not included |
| Stocks Advanced | Real-time |
| Stocks Business | Not included |
| Stocks Business + Expansion | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From WebSocket `T`: "The ticker symbol for the given stock." | WebSocket |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the row, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the New York date of `Timestamp`. | WebSocket |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's primary time, as an Instant. From WebSocket `t`: "The Timestamp in Unix MS." | WebSocket |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | WebSocket |
| `HighPrice` | double | The high price. | WebSocket |
| `LowPrice` | double | The low price. | WebSocket |
| `Indicators` | long[] | The Indicators. See Conditions and Indicators (https://massive.com/glossary/us/stocks/conditions-indicators) for a glossary (LULD indicators are located near the bottom). | WebSocket |
| `Tape` | long | The tape. (1 = NYSE, 2 = AMEX, 3 = Nasdaq). | WebSocket |
| `SequenceNumber` | long | The sequence number represents the sequence in which message events happened. These are increasing and unique per ticker symbol, but will not always be sequential (e.g., 1, 2, 6, 9, 10, 11). | WebSocket |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | WebSocket |
